description: A React functional component named BentoGrid that renders a responsive, asymmetric grid layout composed of multiple cards with varied header gradients, hover effects, and responsive behavior. The component uses Tailwind CSS classes for styling and arranges cards with different column and row spans to create a mosaic-like layout.

methods.name: BentoGrid()
